pairing: Hold two admitted development teams and a mechanics seed fixed; swap policy seats. Reuse each pair across every unordered policy matchup.
interval: Descriptive 95% percentile bootstrap of whole team-seed pairs. Common resampled pair indices across matchups preserve cross-matchup dependence. No promotion or multiple-comparison significance claim.
stopping: Complete all 768 planned games and replay each exactly. A simulator/protocol/cap failure invalidates completion; do not score it as a loss or replace a difficult pair.
selection: Freeze source and plan before the production run. No tuning or opponent replacement after inspecting production outcomes. Any improvement gets a new version and fresh development namespace.
